Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 128. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Melee technique
Ki Cost: 40 ki
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Melee
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
A ki-enhanced dynamic attack that kicks the
surrounding area to pieces. All Creatures within 10 feet
of you must make a Dexterity saving throw or take your
4d(unarmed strike damage die), half on a save.
